card.name: Size comparisons before a measurement or object
card.fires_on: Small words such as "of", "as", "a", "to" or the gap just before a number, in phrases that give an object's size ("about the size of", "as large as", "up to"). The next words are a measurement or a familiar object like a bottle, can or egg.

modes.label: Size-of phrases
modes.description: Linking words in "about the size of" or "as large as" just before a comparison object.

modes.label: Before a measurement
modes.description: The spot just before a number in a length or width range, such as "up to" or "over".
modes.example: Many of the 9-kilogram cephalopods she caught were about<< >>1.2 metres long.

card.writes: It pushes toward household objects used for size comparison (bottle, bowl, egg, fist, palm, cup).
card.plain: It notices when a text is about to say how big something is, often by comparing it to an everyday object.
